Is German a difficult language to learn?

Your manner of speech is very elevated and polite.

What? You haven't spoken a word about it.
to have a pronunciation; to be pronounced (some way)
to pronounce (a judgment, a verdict, etc.)
Die Geschichte wird das endgültige Urteil über sein Werk sprechen.
History will pronounce the final judgement on his work.
to grant, approve (a loan, funding, etc.)
